cartridgeSourcePatch.oldTarget: function targetSurface(){const a=backspoolAdvanced.findAnchor();if(a?.enemySnapshot)return null;const ray=new THREE.Raycaster();ray.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(0,0),camera);const hit=cartridgeTerrainHit(ray.ray);if(hit&&(!a||hit.distance<camera.position.distanceTo(V(a.contact))))return{contact:hit.point,normal:(hit.face?.normal||new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0)).clone().transformDirection(hit.object.matrixWorld),owner:hit.object};return a?{contact:V(a.contact),normal:V(a.normal),owner:a.owner||a.part}:null;}
cartridgeSourcePatch.newTarget: function targetSurface(){const a=backspoolAdvanced.findAnchor();if(a?.enemySnapshot)return null;const ray=new THREE.Raycaster();ray.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(0,0),camera);let surface=a?{contact:V(a.contact),normal:V(a.normal),owner:a.owner||a.part}:null;const owner=a?.owner||a?.part?.owner||a?.part;if(surface&&(owner?.type==='v02-structure'||String(owner?.id||'').startsWith('v02:')))surface=window.verticalDistrict?.cartridgeSurface(ray.ray,String(owner.id),120)||null;const hit=cartridgeTerrainHit(ray.ray);if(hit&&(!surface||hit.distance<camera.position.distanceTo(V(surface.contact))))return{contact:hit.point,normal:(hit.face?.normal||new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0)).clone().transformDirection(hit.object.matrixWorld),owner:hit.object};return surface;}

const cartridgeParts=new Map(),cartridgeChunks=new Map();let cartridgeSurfaceCache=null;
 function cartridgeSurface(ray,ownerId,far=120){if(!state.ready)return null;if(!cartridgeChunks.size)for(const chunk of metadata.chunks)for(const id of chunk.recordIDs)cartridgeChunks.set(id,chunk.id);let item=cartridgeParts.get(ownerId);if(!item){const part=collisions.find(c=>String(c.owner.id)===ownerId);if(!part)return null;const target=root.getObjectByName(cartridgeChunks.get(part.id));if(!target)return null;target.updateWorldMatrix(true,true);item={part,target,envelope:part.box.clone().expandByScalar(.0005)};cartridgeParts.set(ownerId,item);}if(cartridgeSurfaceCache?.ownerId===ownerId&&cartridgeSurfaceCache.far===far&&cartridgeSurfaceCache.origin.equals(ray.origin)&&cartridgeSurfaceCache.direction.equals(ray.direction))return cartridgeSurfaceCache.result;const cast=new THREE.Raycaster(ray.origin,ray.direction,0,far),hit=cast.intersectObject(item.target,true).find(h=>item.envelope.containsPoint(h.point)),result=hit?{contact:hit.point.clone(),normal:hit.face.normal.clone().transformDirection(hit.object.matrixWorld),owner:item.part.owner,part:item.part}:null;cartridgeSurfaceCache={ownerId,far,origin:ray.origin.clone(),direction:ray.direction.clone(),result};return result;}
